edges: Malaria was a major cause of illness and death in Southern Europe throughout the nineteenth century.
Malaria was eradicated from Rome in the 1930s when Mussolini drained the Pontine marshes.
Malaria can cause symptoms such as anemia and lethargy in patients.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The malaria parasite has a life cycle that must pass through both the Anopheles mosquito and human hosts.
When a patient is bitten by an infected mosquito, the parasite is transmitted.
The parasite is passed to humans through the saliva of infected Anopheles mosquitoes.

edges: Malaria is still infecting people in the UK despite being effectively eradicated.
